beats.label: S1 · Canterbury nuked
beats.text: The ice hauler Canterbury answers a distress call and is destroyed by stealth ships, leaving XO Jim Holden and a small away crew as the only survivors.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This is the inciting attack that forms the Rocinante crew and puts the protomolecule mystery in motion.

beats.label: S1 · Miller takes the case
beats.text: On Ceres, jaded detective Joe Miller is hired to find heiress Julie Mao and becomes obsessed enough to be fired, tracing her ties to the militant Belter OPA.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Miller's Julie thread is the wire that connects Ceres, the OPA, and the protomolecule together.

beats.label: S1 · The broadcast
beats.text: To keep his crew alive, Holden broadcasts that the Canterbury was killed by Martian tech, igniting protests across the Belt and pushing Earth and Mars toward war.
beats.whyLoadBearing: It brands Holden a war-starter and hard-wires the political tension every later season inherits.

beats.label: S1 · Rocinante is born
beats.text: The same stealth ships gut the Martian flagship Donnager; Holden's crew escapes on a captured frigate they rename Rocinante and dock with OPA-tied Fred Johnson at Tycho.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The ship and the Tycho alliance are the crew's base of operations from here on.

beats.label: S1 · Avasarala smells a setup
beats.text: In New York, UN deputy Chrisjen Avasarala plays Errinwright and the Martian ambassador and realises a third party is trying to spark the war.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Avasarala's private investigation is the thread that will pull Errinwright and Mao into the light.

beats.label: S1 · Eros sealed
beats.text: Miller and Holden converge on Eros to find Julie killed by an alien 'protomolecule'; Jules-Pierre Mao's men seal the station and infect its poor as living incubators.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This is the first live protomolecule outbreak — the emergency the whole next season is chasing.

beats.label: S1 · Errinwright unmasked
beats.text: The Rocinante crew barely escape irradiated Eros; Avasarala matches the reactor tech to a program Errinwright is shielding and quietly ships her family to Luna.
beats.whyLoadBearing: She now knows her own government is the enemy — the private knowledge that arms her for the political war ahead.

cliffhanger.text: Eros is a live protomolecule experiment run by Jules-Pierre Mao behind Errinwright's back; the Rocinante crew and Miller escape irradiated and hunted, and Avasarala privately knows a rogue faction inside her own government helped light the fuse.
questions: What is the protomolecule doing to the sealed population of Eros?
Who else inside the UN is backing Errinwright and Mao?
What will Miller do now that he has confirmed Julie is dead?

characters.name: Jim Holden
characters.line: Former XO of the Canterbury, now reluctant captain of the captured Martian frigate Rocinante, harbouring the sample of an alien 'protomolecule' he found on Eros.

characters.name: Joe Miller
characters.line: Disgraced Ceres detective who followed the Julie Mao case to Eros and watched it become ground zero for a protomolecule outbreak deliberately unleashed on the station's poor.

characters.name: Chrisjen Avasarala
characters.line: UN deputy undersecretary in New York who has quietly concluded a third party — not Mars — is driving the war and that her own boss Errinwright is shielding them.

characters.name: Julie Mao
characters.line: OPA-sympathising heiress whose disappearance drew Miller into the case; found dead on Eros, her body the first human host of the protomolecule.

characters.name: Jules-Pierre Mao
characters.line: Ruthless Earth industrialist and Julie's father, secretly bankrolling the protomolecule experiment that turned Eros into a living incubator.

characters.name: Fred Johnson
characters.line: Former UN colonel turned OPA leader at Tycho Station, now sheltering Holden's crew and the Rocinante in exchange for a foothold in the crisis.

characters.name: Sadavir Errinwright
characters.line: UN Undersecretary above Avasarala, revealed to be protecting the black program behind the protomolecule attacks.

beats.label: S2 · Two moons die
beats.text: Mars nukes Phoebe Station to erase the protomolecule's origin and Earth retaliates by destroying the Martian moon Deimos; the Solar System sits one incident away from open war.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the war footing that Errinwright will exploit and Avasarala will spend the season trying to defuse.

beats.label: S2 · Miller kills Dresden
beats.text: The Rocinante and Fred Johnson's OPA storm Thoth Station and capture project lead Dresden; before he can talk his way free, Miller executes him and fractures the alliance.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills the one man who could explain the protomolecule and isolates Miller inside his own crew.

beats.label: S2 · Eros crashes into Venus
beats.text: Eros wakes and steers itself at Earth; Miller carries a bomb to its heart and talks a protomolecule-hybrid Julie into crashing them both into Venus instead.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Miller from the board and plants the protomolecule on Venus, where it will visibly start building something.

beats.label: S2 · Ganymede falls
beats.text: On Ganymede, MCRN gunnery sergeant Bobbie Draper watches her squad slaughtered by an inhuman figure while the orbital battle above devastates the moon's food domes.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Bobbie and the hybrid weapon, and creates the Belt-wide hunger crisis pushing everyone toward war.

beats.label: S2 · Mao cornered
beats.text: Avasarala engineers a peace summit on Earth; Bobbie's off-book testimony convinces her Jules-Pierre Mao is selling a protomolecule weapon to both governments.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This alliance between Bobbie and Avasarala is the axis of the next season's political thriller.

beats.label: S2 · Hybrid on the Rocinante
beats.text: Bobbie defects and Avasarala meets Mao aboard his yacht; his ambush is broken by her power armour, while a hybrid monster smuggles itself onto the Rocinante.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Bobbie is now Avasarala's asset and the crew have a live weapon on their ship — the emergency that opens the next chapter.

beats.label: S2 · Naomi's confession
beats.text: The crew kill the hybrid, but Naomi admits she gave the protomolecule sample to Fred Johnson so the Belt would have leverage; meanwhile Venus is being visibly remade.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Detonates the crew's trust and hands the Belt its own protomolecule — a card that reshapes the balance of power.

cliffhanger.text: Miller is gone and Eros is on Venus, but Mao's program continues on Io using kidnapped Ganymede children — including Prax's daughter Mei — while the Belt now quietly holds its own protomolecule sample and Venus is being remade in plain sight.
questions: What is the protomolecule building on Venus?
What are Mao's hybrids being engineered for?
Now that Fred Johnson holds a protomolecule sample, what will the Belt do with it?

characters.name: Chrisjen Avasarala
characters.line: UN power broker who has openly turned on Errinwright's faction and, after Bobbie's testimony, is convinced Jules-Pierre Mao is selling a protomolecule weapon to both governments.

characters.name: Bobbie Draper
characters.line: MCRN gunnery sergeant, sole survivor of a Ganymede squad wiped out by a protomolecule hybrid, who has defected to Earth and become Avasarala's protector.

characters.name: Naomi Nagata
characters.line: Rocinante's Belter engineer, now revealed to have secretly handed a sample of the protomolecule to Fred Johnson so the Belt would not be left defenceless.

characters.name: Joe Miller
characters.line: Broken ex-detective who executes the protomolecule project's lead scientist Dresden, then rides a bomb into Eros and, with a hybrid Julie, steers the station into Venus.

characters.name: Julie Mao
characters.line: Now a protomolecule-hybrid consciousness inside Eros; Miller talks her into diverting the station away from Earth and crashing them both into Venus.

characters.name: Fred Johnson
characters.line: OPA leader at Tycho whose alliance with the Rocinante fractures after Miller's kill on Thoth, and who is quietly holding Naomi's protomolecule sample as Belt leverage.

characters.name: Jules-Pierre Mao
characters.line: Fugitive industrialist peddling a protomolecule weapon to both Earth and Mars, whose attempted ambush of Avasarala aboard his yacht is broken by Bobbie's power armour.

beats.label: S3 · Errinwright frames Avasarala
beats.text: Errinwright frames Avasarala as Mao's ally and pushes Earth into open war with Mars; the Rocinante rescues her and Bobbie as fleets converge on Mao's lab at Io.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This is the political detonation that fuses every faction's plot into one point at Io.

beats.label: S3 · Battle of Io
beats.text: At Io, rogue Admiral Nguyen fires hybrid warheads; an infected Cotyar destroys the UN flagship to contain them, Mao is captured, and Fred Johnson downs the rest.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends Mao's hybrid program and takes the protomolecule off the war chessboard — clearing space for what Venus is about to send.

beats.label: S3 · Errinwright falls, Belt legitimised
beats.text: Pastor Anna Volovodov forces the UN to arrest Errinwright with a leaked confession; peace holds, and the OPA under Dawes and Fred Johnson is recognised as the government of the Belt.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Avasarala's antagonist and turns the Belt into a real political actor for the first time.

beats.label: S3 · The Ring appears
beats.text: The protomolecule finishes a Ring beyond Uranus; Earth, Mars and the Belt each send fleets, with Camina Drummer captaining the OPA's converted Behemoth and Naomi at her side.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Ring is the new plot engine and the pretext that puts every faction's flagship in one place.

beats.label: S3 · Miller returns, Clarissa boards
beats.text: A construct of Miller starts appearing only to Holden, pulling him toward the Ring; Mao's other daughter Clarissa boards under an alias to frame and kill Holden for her father.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reintroduces Miller as the protomolecule's messenger and plants Clarissa as the human threat inside the fleet.

beats.label: S3 · Slow zone
beats.text: The Ring's station clamps every ship to near-stillness, killing many; Holden touches the alien core and sees that the protomolecule's makers were themselves wiped out by something.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals the real threat is not the protomolecule but whatever killed its creators — the shadow behind everything to come.

beats.label: S3 · 1300 gates open
beats.text: Ashford tries to blow the Ring; Holden powers every ship down and calms the station, which instead opens 1300 gates to habitable systems and hands humanity a frontier.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This is the map change that redefines every faction's ambitions and drives the whole next chapter.

cliffhanger.text: The Ring's station has opened gates to 1300 habitable systems and handed humanity a frontier no government is ready for; the protomolecule's makers were killed by something unknown that is still out there, and no faction agrees on who gets to claim what.
questions: Who will control the 1300 new worlds — Earth, Mars, or the Belt?
What killed the protomolecule's builders, and is it still watching?
With Miller gone, who guides Holden through what the station showed him?

characters.name: Jim Holden
characters.line: Rocinante captain drawn toward the newly-formed Ring by visions of Miller; after touching the alien core he alone knows the protomolecule's makers were themselves annihilated.

characters.name: Naomi Nagata
characters.line: Rocinante engineer serving alongside Drummer aboard the OPA's converted Behemoth as the Belt takes its place beside Earth and Mars at the Ring.

characters.name: Chrisjen Avasarala
characters.line: Vindicated UN leader who, with Pastor Anna's leaked confession, has finally seen Errinwright arrested and peace restored between Earth and Mars.

characters.name: Bobbie Draper
characters.line: Martian marine attached to Avasarala's circle, present at Io when Nguyen's hybrid warheads are stopped and Mao is captured.

characters.name: Klaes Ashford
characters.line: Belter captain aboard the Behemoth who tries to destroy the Ring to save humanity, only to be overruled when Holden calms the station.

characters.name: Camina Drummer
characters.line: OPA officer captaining the Behemoth at the Ring, standing with Naomi as the Belt claims its seat among the powers.

characters.name: Jules-Pierre Mao
characters.line: Captured at Io after Admiral Nguyen's hybrid-warhead gambit collapses, ending his private protomolecule war.

characters.name: Sadavir Errinwright
characters.line: Exposed by Pastor Anna's leaked confession and arrested by the UN, ending his campaign to frame Avasarala and force war with Mars.

characters.name: Fred Johnson
characters.line: OPA leader who downs Nguyen's remaining ships at Io and is recognised, alongside Dawes, as the legitimate government of the Belt.

beats.label: S4 · Race to Ilus
beats.text: With the gates open, Belter refugees settle a world called Ilus over Earth's blockade; Avasarala sends Holden as her envoy just as an Earth corporate expedition arrives to compete.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the template for the whole new-frontier era — Belters plant flags first, Inners follow with money and guns.

beats.label: S4 · Belters vs Earthers
beats.text: Naomi dopes herself onto drugs to survive Ilus's gravity but never fully adapts; on the surface, settlers and Earth security chief Adolphus Murtry escalate into open gunfire.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shows Belters can survive down a well but not comfortably, and puts a face on Earth corporate ruthlessness in the colonies.

beats.label: S4 · Bobbie on Mars
beats.text: On Mars, Bobbie fails to find honest work and joins Detective Esai Martin's arms-trafficking gang, uncovering that Martian military hardware is quietly leaking out to the Belt.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Bobbie stumbling onto the Mars-to-Belt weapons pipeline is the intel that later explains where Marco's arsenal came from.

beats.label: S4 · Ilus turns hostile
beats.text: Guided by Miller, Holden reactivates a dormant alien machine and triggers cascading disasters on Ilus — lightning, quakes, a tsunami, and a plague that blinds every settler.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Confirms the new worlds are booby-trapped with the leftover tech of a killed civilisation, not empty real estate.

beats.label: S4 · Marco Inaros surfaces
beats.text: OPA peacekeepers Drummer and Ashford catch Naomi's ex-lover Marco Inaros stealing a UN colony ship and executing its passengers, but Belt politics acquit him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the season's real villain and shows the OPA cannot police its own radicals.

beats.label: S4 · Miller finishes his job
beats.text: On Ilus, Miller pushes a metal proxy body through an alien artefact and shuts down every protomolecule process on the planet; he is gone for good.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes out the Miller thread completely and severs Holden's line to the protomolecule's ancient civilisation.

beats.label: S4 · Gao wins, Marco strikes
beats.text: Avasarala loses the UN election to Nancy Gao; Ashford tracks Marco down but is killed by Naomi's son Filip, and Marco launches stealth-coated asteroids at Earth.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This is the ending: no political top cover, the one man who could stop Marco is dead, and cloaked rocks are already in flight.

cliffhanger.text: Marco Inaros has launched Martian-stealth asteroids at an Earth that cannot see them coming; Avasarala is out of office, Ashford is dead with a hidden warning nobody has found, and Bobbie is sitting on the smoking-gun evidence of the Mars-to-Belt weapons pipeline.
questions: Will Ashford's hidden recording ever reach anyone who can stop Marco?
What happens when the stealth asteroids hit an unwarned Earth?
With Avasarala sidelined, who will act on what Bobbie now knows about Mars?

characters.name: Jim Holden
characters.line: Avasarala's envoy on the new-frontier world of Ilus, guided by a Miller-construct to reactivate an alien machine that unleashes cascading disasters on the settlers.

characters.name: Naomi Nagata
characters.line: Rocinante engineer struggling with Ilus's gravity, now confronted on the Belt side by the reappearance of her ex-lover Marco Inaros and their son Filip.

characters.name: Chrisjen Avasarala
characters.line: UN Secretary-General who loses her re-election to Nancy Gao just as Marco Inaros's stealth asteroids race toward Earth.

characters.name: Bobbie Draper
characters.line: Ex-marine unable to find honest work on Mars, now embedded in Esai Martin's smuggling ring and uncovering that Martian military hardware is being funnelled to the Belt.

characters.name: Marco Inaros
characters.line: Belter warlord and Naomi's ex-lover, acquitted after hijacking a UN colony ship and now launching stealth-coated asteroids at Earth.

characters.name: Camina Drummer
characters.line: OPA peacekeeper who captured Inaros only to see Belt politics set him free, then lost her partner Ashford to his crew.

characters.name: Joe Miller
characters.line: Protomolecule-driven construct guiding Holden on Ilus, who pushes a proxy body through an alien artefact to shut down every process on the planet and is gone for good.

characters.name: Klaes Ashford
characters.line: OPA peacekeeper who hunted Marco Inaros to the edge of the Belt and was killed there by Naomi's son Filip.
